name: Instacart Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase and balance transfer APR 18.49% to 27.99% variable based on creditworthiness; cash advance APR 28.74% variable; penalty APR up to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: Pricing & Terms list foreign transaction fees as None.

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases.

categories.label: Qualifying Instacart.com and Instacart app purchases
Restaurants (including orders on Instacart powered by Uber Eats), gas stations and select streaming services

signup_bonus.description: $50 Instacart credit loaded into the Instacart account automatically upon approval.

notes: Issued by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. Earn rates and fees come from the Chase product page and Pricing & Terms page. The product page footnote names both World Mastercard and World Elite Mastercard as trademarks without saying which package the card carries, so network_tier is recorded as none.
